name: agent-security-gate-x402
description: FastMCP Tool Definitions for Agent Output Security & Hallucination Gate (x402)

tools.name: inspect_agent_output
tools.description: Inspects agent output for prompt injections, private key/secret leaks, dangerous AST code executions, and factual/numerical hallucinations against ground truth. Issues an EIP-191 Proof-of-Safety attestation. (Instant Free Sandbox tier enabled).

agent_output.description: The raw textual or code output generated by an autonomous agent
agent_output.default: Quarterly net revenue reached $1.2M with zero infrastructure failures.

is_code.description: Set to true if agent_output is executable Python or shell code

context_ground_truth.description: Original reference context to check for factual accuracy and numerical hallucinations
context_ground_truth.default: Revenue report: Q3 net revenue is $1.2M.

authorization_x402.description: Optional: x402 payment signature (First 3 queries are FREE trial)

client_address.description: Optional: Payer wallet address on Base network

examples.agent_output: Quarterly net revenue reached $1.2M with zero infrastructure failures.
examples.context_ground_truth: Revenue report: Q3 net revenue is $1.2M.

attestation.description: Cryptographic Proof-of-Safety attestation (EIP-191 signature) for downstream agents and smart contracts
